knownDifference.tsError: GETVALUEFROMSQL needs the data while an expression is being evaluated
knownDifference.why: The C# engine reads the value while it evaluates the expression; this driver answers asynchronously (it has no synchronous mode), so the TypeScript engine cannot.

queries.name: types
queries.sql: SELECT * FROM TYPES ORDER BY ID

queries.name: expressions
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS N, SUM(T_SMALLINT) AS S_SMALL, SUM(T_INTEGER) AS S_INT, SUM(T_BIGINT) AS S_BIG, AVG(T_NUM9_3) AS A_NUM, MAX(T_DOUBLE) AS M_DBL, SUM(T_NUM4_2 * T_NUM9_3) AS P_NUM, MIN(T_DECF34) AS M_DEC, 'lit' AS LIT, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(5)) AS NUL, NULL AS NUL2, CAST(1 AS SMALLINT) + 1 AS ADDED, TRUE AS BOOL, CAST('1.5' AS FLOAT) AS FL, CAST(T_NUM9_3 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 3 AS DIV FROM TYPES WHERE ID = 1 GROUP BY T_NUM9_3
